comment: The fridolin-core container's seccomp profile (docs/CORE.md). Docker's default profile refuses unshare, clone with namespace flags, mount, umount2, pivot_root and setns to a process without CAP_SYS_ADMIN, so bubblewrap cannot give a brain's run its own user, mount and PID namespaces. This profile allows those and refuses the rest of what Docker's default refuses: kernel modules, kexec, keyrings, bpf, perf, ptrace and cross-process memory, userfaultfd, io_uring, the new mount API, clock and swap changes, reboot. The container runs without capabilities, so most of these would fail anyway; the list keeps the kernel surface small.
